senses.gloss: press.—Pl. כְּבָשִׁים, כְּבָשִׁין. Pesik. Eth. Korb., p. 61ᵇ (play on כבשים, Num. XXVIII, 3) כ׳ שהן כובשין וכ׳ (the sacrifices are) presses, for they suppress the sins &c.; Pesik. R. s. 16.

units: Sabb. XVI, 8; a. e.—Esp. the inclined plane leading to the altar.
Zeb. V, 3; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Zevachim 63a:1">Ib. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>כל כִּבְשִי כבשים … חוץ של מזבח וכ׳</he> all grades of ascents (in the Temple) were at the rate of three cubits per one cubit (of vertical elevation), except the ascent of the altar which was at the rate of three cubits and a half and &c.; (for Var. lect. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., and Tosaf. a. l. a.

Men. 41ᵇ s. v. ארבעה); Y. Erub. II, 24ᵇ bot., v. כִּיבּוּשׁ h.—Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2); Koh. R. to XII, 7 (expl. דָּיֵק, Ez. XXI, 27) כ׳ embankments round a besieged city (Lat. agger, v. כּוֹבֵשׁ).
Ter. II, 6 זיתי כ׳ olives good for preserves, opp. זתי שמן.—Pl. as ab. pressed, preserved vegetables &c., Shebi. IX, 5 הכובש שלשה כ׳ וכ׳ if one puts three sorts of pressed vegetables into one vessel.
